## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD4: INSTALL.md includes PR-mode setup instructions for projects using merge.strategy=pr

## Implementation

File: INSTALL.md (modify)

Under the "Getting Started with /dso:onboarding" section, add a short subsection "PR-Mode Projects":

"### PR-Mode Projects (GitHub Ruleset Enforcement)

If your project uses GitHub Ruleset enforcement for all merges, set `merge.strategy=pr` in `.claude/dso-config.conf`. During `/dso:onboarding`, you will be prompted to choose between direct (default) and pr merge modes. Selecting pr:
1. Writes `merge.strategy=pr` to `.claude/dso-config.conf`
2. Automatically provisions a GitHub Ruleset via `provision-ruleset.sh`
3. All subsequent merges use `merge-to-main-pr.sh` (PR-based workflow with CI gate)

To switch an existing project to PR mode, update `dso-config.conf` directly and run `bash .claude/scripts/dso provision-ruleset.sh --repo <owner/repo>`."

Keep it concise (under 10 lines). Follow DOCUMENTATION-GUIDE.md conventions.

## TDD Requirement
Non-executable instruction file — Rule 5 of behavioral-testing-standard.md applies. Structural boundary test only.
Test: `grep -q 'merge\.strategy=pr\|PR.*[Mm]ode\|provision-ruleset' INSTALL.md`
Must FAIL before the change and PASS after.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] merge.strategy=pr mentioned in INSTALL.md
  Verify: grep -q 'merge\.strategy=pr' INSTALL.md
- [ ] PR-mode section present
  Verify: grep -qi 'PR.*mode\|PR-mode\|PR Mode' INSTALL.md
- [ ] provision-ruleset.sh referenced
  Verify: grep -q 'provision-ruleset' INSTALL.md

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet->opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: Update INSTALL.md with PR-mode setup instructions
